degree_rationale: How the pure living soul stands as the second ploughed-field within the entire Zone, with sun and moon as the two great Luminaries doing farmer-work upon her. Closes natural-south by illumining the soul as cultivated-field of the cosmic farmers.
direction_rationale: Closes natural-south with the bright agricultural illumination — the soul as field, luminaries as farmers. South-quality of seen-cultivation.
grand_man_function: Natural soul-as-field illumination — luminaries cultivating soul.
title: How the pure soul stands free in the zone above
